To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
financial constraints can lead to a U shaped investment strategy and to a non monotone relationship between the incumbent firm's profit and the expected innovation speed.

the speed of product innovations is a non-monotone function of the incumbent firm's profit on the market for the old product and that financial constraints can lead the firm to speed up innovation by going into debt.
financial constraints can be a blessing or a curse for the speed of innovation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of financial constraints for the optimal investment behavior of an incumbent firm that is engaged in product innovation under technological and demand uncertainty.
the interaction between technological and financial uncertainty in the context of product innovation.

the interaction between product innovation, financial constraints and market uncertainty and shows that the speed of innovation is not only a function of technological uncertainty but also of the financial situation of the innovator.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
financial contraints can be a source of market power and a driver of innovation.
financial constraints can be an important determinant of the speed of product innovations.
the optimal R&D strategy of a firm is not only determined by its technological environment but also by the financial constraints it faces and by the market environment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, under financial constraints, firms are forced to trade off the benefits and costs of speeding up product innovation.
, due to financial constraints, the firm is able to speed up innovation, but only at a price.
financial contraints have a non trivial impact on the speed of product development.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the existence of financial contraint can have a strong impact on the firm's investment and innovation strategies.
, in a dynamic market setting, financial constraints can be a source of innovation and market power for the incumbent firm.
the speed of product innovations can be affected by financial constraints.
